exposure: Location of the demised fetus (presenting vs. non-presenting)
outcome: Gestational age of the remaining fetus at delivery
cohort: The study included 80 pregnant women with twin pregnancies experiencing one fetal demise after the first trimester (14 weeks of gestation) between September 2004 and September 2022.
finding: When the presenting fetus is demised in a twin pregnancy, the remaining fetus tends to be delivered earlier than when the non-presenting fetus is demised.
gest_age: Fetal demise occurred after 14 weeks of gestation; mean gestational age at delivery for the remaining fetus was 33.8 weeks in Group 1 and 37.3 weeks in Group 2.
